# W6-006 — Implement scene soundscape controller

- Phase: W6
- Status: `done`
- Priority: P1
- Role: implementer
- Dependencies: W6-005, W5-004
- Parallel group: serial
- Risk: low
- Human approval required: false

## Objective

Integrate optional scene ambience without coupling playback to hover/scroll.

## Scope hints

- `packages/ui/src`
- `apps/board/src`

## Deliverables

- Soundscape controller and settings integration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Default is muted.
- [x] One or policy-limited set of sources only; avoid overlapping loops.
- [x] Scene changes stop/fade old ambience.
- [x] Audio failure cannot break UX.

## Verification

- `pnpm test:ui`
- `browser audio tests`

## Completion record

- Commands / exit codes:
  - `dependency audit: W6-005 status and notes` — exit 0
  - `node --test packages/ui/tests/scene-components.test.mjs packages/ui/tests/scene-fx-audio.test.mjs` — exit 0
  - `pnpm test:assets` — exit 0
  - `pnpm test:ui` — exit 0
  - `pnpm --filter @moonwitness/ui-catalog exec playwright test tests/fx-lab.spec.ts tests/scene-harness.spec.ts --workers=1` — exit 0
- Evidence paths:
  - `evidence/W6-W7-execution.md`
  - `evidence/W6-W7-execution.md; existing controller contract 6/6 passed but is not scene ambience integration`
  - `evidence/W6-ambience-pack.md; 56 asset tests and static docs export verification passed`
  - `evidence/W6-ambience-pack.md; 71 UI tests passed`
  - `evidence/W6-ambience-pack.md; 12 browser tests passed, including consent, source switching, mute, responsive scene diagnostics`
- Commit SHA: 5f91fc232062200e83643e0358677335936ee0ff
- Reviewer decision: Acceptance evidence recorded.
- Residual issues: Integrated the scene ambience controller with canonical ambience assets. Playback remains muted until gesture and opt-in, only one source plays, source changes and mute pause prior audio, missing sources stay silent, volume is capped in FX Lab, and playback errors are contained.
